title: Shaun the Sheep Toilet Roll Holder
author: BrickBeat
description:
An eye-catcher and emergency helper in one. Behold the sheep as a toilet paper roll holder.

In this version, the rear end has been shortened, making it easier to disassemble the parts to access the desired roll.

Update April 25: I have added a printing plate for rolls with a smaller diameter; there is now a choice between 42mm and 39mm
